## TRA Timeline

#### Parsley Energy's Up-C IPO
 - 2014-01-24: First public S-1 filing with unexecuted TRA filed as exhibit
 - 2014-05-29: Reported completion of Up-C IPO and filing of executed TRA

#### Acquisition by Pioneer Natural Resources
 - 2020-10-21: Announced a plan of merger with Pioneer Natural Resources, and a TRA amendment which would terminate the TRA with a negotiated payment following completion of the merger
 - 2021-01-12: Reported completion of the merger
